summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it, then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing heavy string-array/index-shuffle obfuscation (a `WV8StW` rotator function permuting a large mixed literal array, hex-name identifiers) with no code related to time/date parsing. The package is advertised as a time/date string parser and has no functional need for a second language runtime at install. The pattern — an install-time loader that pulls an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload outside Node-based tooling — is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape. The Bun runtime source (github.com/oven-sh) is official for Bun itself, but the code Bun then executes is the package's own opaque, obfuscated `math_init.js`, whose runtime behavior cannot be inspected without execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
